WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill_size
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), first_stage AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, avg_fill_size,
         avg_fill_size - (SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) FROM per_order) AS margin1
  FROM per_order
  WHERE avg_fill_size > (SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) FROM per_order)
), second_stage AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, avg_fill_size, margin1,
         avg_fill_size - (SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) FROM first_stage) AS margin2
  FROM first_stage
  WHERE avg_fill_size > (SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) FROM first_stage)
)
SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS avg_per_order_fill_size,
       AVG(margin1) AS avg_margin_over_first_benchmark,
       AVG(margin2) AS avg_margin_over_second_benchmark
FROM second_stage;
